name: Notes relay
summary: The lectures before an exam as a running track, one lap per lecture: covered laps are solid with the note-taker's face, claimed laps show who's typing, gaps glow red; members take a gap, mark their notes up and the baton runs on, and a full track before the exam gets a group cheer.
useWhen: midterm in two weeks and nobody has week 4
can we split up taking notes for econ
who has the notes from tuesday's lecture
let's do a notes rotation for the rest of the semester
missing lecture notes before the final, who can cover
dontUseWhen: a quiz to review content (use exam-quiz)

finish.description: The deadline, as said, e.g. 'Midterm Thu Oct 30'

by.description: Who took or is taking notes; empty if nobody

done.description: True when the notes are up

said.description: What the note-taker said, in their words
